question: Can a fixed finite observation-preservation contract survive representation changes and worklist splits with complete coverage, distinct histories and a strictly decreasing shared work budget?
arithmetic_domain: Z with exact Python integers, strict integer types excluding bool; coefficients in [-3,3], evaluation intermediates bounded to 128 bits
source_representation: expanded-v0: a*x*x + b*x + c, with an ordered five-operation trace
target_representation: horner-v0: (a*x+b)*x+c, with an ordered four-operation trace
quantifier: for every x in the declared finite input set
observation: exact integer value equality under identity input/output correspondence; execution histories remain separate
representation_invariants: question version, domain, quantifier, input set, observer, source and target representation versions and coefficients
source/target histories retained rather than identified
display names are excluded from question binding only
changed scope cannot consume an unchanged receipt as if its applicability were already established
worklist_invariant: D = checked points disjoint-union all pending blocks, after every committed transition
split_policy: Replace one pending block with exactly two nonempty ordered proper subblocks; no duplicate atoms, disjoint union equals parent; maximum arity2, depth6, pending atoms7; no per-child fuel field. Generate midpoint split in this fixture.
termination_argument: Phi=sum(|block|-1) decreases by one at every valid binary split; at most6 splits. Psi=sum(2*|block|-1) decreases by one at every split or leaf check; at most13 successful work steps. All attempts additionally cost shared fuel. This is not general termination for arbitrary new obligations.
accounting: One global invocation meter <=2000. Each case has a declared total ledger E+64, with E work units and64 reserved for final independent checking and checkpoint serialization. All nodes share that ledger, no child balances. Every split attempt/whole point check costs at least1 work unit. Invalid proposals spend their attempted work and preserve the old frontier. Final checking/serialization consume the same total ledger; a reserve is not a new grant.

cases.mode: reuse main receipt under display-only task rename
reuse main receipt with changed input set
main receipt with an extra pending block

verification: Independent receipt checker reconstructs queue transitions, coverage, resource charges and source/target arithmetic (separate polynomial computation); checks preserved distinct traces. Producer and checker share Python integers, not independent runtimes. Reconstruct serialized main and partial-Unknown reports under the same global budget.
success: All declared outcomes agree with independently checked receipts; main/fresh cover all seven points, unchanged display-name interpretation, invalid splits preserve coverage, zero/partial work retain Unknown frontier, two serialized reconstructions match; no automatic continuation
scope: External finite obligation-partition and observation-preservation calibration; not a native CausalCut, ProgramSlice, identity, M6 filler, recursive splitter, native free, universal grammar proof, new compiler theorem, automatic direction selection or acceleration. No repository moves.
costs: Measure construction/work, final verification, serialization/replay, fresh reuse and process RSS; phases may overlap and must be labelled; source authoring/research/network costs Missing if unmeasured.
word: Refines proposed research workflow; no new primitive or library research API rename
